headlines.title_en: Wallstreet CN Breakfast | September 10, 2026
headlines.summary_en: Oil above $100 and ahead of inflation data, US stocks fell for a third consecutive session; Meta jumped 6% against the trend; US Treasuries declined across the board. A blockbuster move fell short—Treasury buybacks tripled in scale but the $6 billion only hit the low end of expectations; the 10-year Treasury yield rose above 4.84%, hitting a new high since November 2023. Trump said the Iran conflict would end 'immediately' after the US midterms. Iran announced a new maritime 'sanctions zone' and attacked a US military base; the US military struck Iranian oil tankers. Escalating Middle East tensions pushed Brent crude above $100 a barrel for the first time in over a month, settling at $101.21. China's Ministry of Commerce said the US 'AI distillation' accusation is about pushing tech hegemony and monopolizing computing power, which China firmly opposes. China's August CPI rose 0.8% year on year, widening its gain, while PPI rose 3.8% year on year; both turned positive month on month, driven by higher international oil prices and seasonal food price increases.

headlines.title: 定向可转债市场化改革提速，在房地产行业应用场景有望进一步丰富
headlines.summary: 中国证监会8月底发布《关于资本市场支持构建房地产发展新模式的意见》，支持上市房企通过向特定对象发行方式再融资，并支持上市房企综合运用股份、定向可转债、现金等工具收购涉房资产。从已发行案例看，定向可转债在并购重组中主要扮演兼具债底保护与股性弹性的创新支付工具角色。业内人士认为，在房地产领域，定向可转债此前主要承担项目融资功能，未来随着行业并购需求上升，其在房地产行业中的应用场景有望进一步丰富。业内人士表示，今年已披露预案的定向可转债已达12只，远高于去年同期，具备发行扩容的基础。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Reforms to accelerate market-based convertible bonds pick up pace, with potential for broader applications in the real estate sector
headlines.summary_en: In late August, the CSRC issued the Opinions on Supporting the Capital Market to Build a New Model for Real Estate Development, backing listed property developers in refinancing via targeted issuance and using tools such as shares, targeted convertible bonds, and cash to acquire real estate-related assets. Based on issued cases, targeted convertible bonds mainly serve as an innovative payment instrument in M&A that combines downside bond protection with equity upside elasticity. Industry insiders say that in real estate, targeted convertible bonds previously mainly served project financing functions; going forward, as industry M&A demand rises, their application scenarios in the sector may further expand. Insiders note that 12 targeted convertible bonds with disclosed plans have been issued this year, far more than in the same period last year, laying the groundwork for expanded issuance. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 中国资产“确定性”筑牢资本市场内在稳定性
headlines.summary: 近期，市场对“流动性”的讨论有所升温。从全球市场看，以美债为代表的多国国债收益率飙升，引发市场对流动性挤压的普遍担忧；从A股市场看，近两天成交额有所缩减，有声音解读为市场流动性趋紧的信号。多位市场专家接受采访认为，当前A股流动性仍处于健康区间，从长期看，中国经济及政策稳定性、科技创新加快引领产业格局变迁以及全球市场对中国资产安全性的认可，都将推动A股独立定价能力进一步夯实。 (上证报)

headlines.title_en: Certainty of Chinese assets underpins internal stability of capital markets
headlines.summary_en: Recently, market discussion of 'liquidity' has intensified. Globally, yields on government bonds including US Treasuries have surged, triggering widespread worries about liquidity strain; in A-shares, trading volume has shrunk over the past two days, with some interpreting it as a sign of tightening liquidity. Multiple market experts said in interviews that current A-share liquidity remains in a healthy range; over the long term, China's economic and policy stability, technological innovation accelerating industrial landscape changes, and global market recognition of Chinese asset safety will all further solidify A-shares' independent pricing capability. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 券商秋季策略会展望：A股“金秋行情”有望延续，扩散和均衡主导配置
headlines.summary: 金秋九月，2026年券商秋季策略会密集召开。截至9月9日，华福证券、西部证券、财通证券、天风证券等多家券商已召开秋季策略会。梳理发现，在外围市场不确定性延续的背景下，券商普遍对国内资本市场后市表现持积极态度。同时，券商投研重心已由上半年的科技“一枝独秀”明显转向“多元均衡”配置，大消费、地产链等板块的关注度显著回升。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Brokers' autumn strategy outlook: A-share 'golden autumn rally' likely to continue, with diversification and balance dominating allocation
headlines.summary_en: In golden September, securities firms' 2026 autumn strategy conferences are being held intensively. As of September 9, several brokerages including Huafu Securities, Western Securities, Caitong Securities, and Tianfeng Securities have held autumn strategy conferences. A review shows that amid persistent uncertainty in external markets, brokerages generally hold a positive view on the outlook for domestic capital markets. Meanwhile, brokerages' investment research focus has clearly shifted from the first half's tech-'only-bright-spot' stance to 'diversified and balanced' allocation, with attention on consumer and real estate chain sectors notably rebounding. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title_en: U.S. Treasury yields rise across the board; Treasury bond buyback program triggers a short-term rally
headlines.summary_en: Wednesday (September 9) New York close: the US 10-year Treasury yield rose 4.23 basis points to 4.8305%. Before the US Treasury disclosed Thursday's bond purchase amount at 23:00 Beijing time, it stayed slightly higher, mainly trading near 4.8%, then spiked briefly after, reaching 4.8528% at 23:24, approaching the intraday high of 5.0187% from October 23, 2023, on the daily chart. The 2-year yield rose 2.76 basis points to 4.4211%, reaching 4.4295% at 02:49, approaching the July 11, 2024 top of 4.6409% and the April 30, 2024 top of 5.0434%; the 20-year yield rose 3.36 basis points to 5.2856%, reaching 5.3194% after the buyback plan was released; the 30-year yield rose 4.

headlines.title: 央行：存款保险不是商业保险 保费无需储户承担
headlines.summary: 中国证监会8月底发布《关于资本市场支持构建房地产发展新模式的意见》，支持上市房企通过向特定对象发行方式再融资，并支持上市房企综合运用股份、定向可转债、现金等工具收购涉房资产。从已发行案例看，定向可转债在并购重组中主要扮演兼具债底保护与股性弹性的创新支付工具角色。业内人士认为，在房地产领域，定向可转债此前主要承担项目融资功能，未来随着行业并购需求上升，其在房地产行业中的应用场景有望进一步丰富。业内人士表示，今年已披露预案的定向可转债已达12只，远高于去年同期，具备发行扩容的基础。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: 27th China International Optoelectronic Expo opens in Shenzhen, with AI and localization as dual drivers, sustaining high prosperity across the optical communications industry chain
headlines.summary_en: From optical fiber to optical modules, from optical chips to electrical chips, booths of every related listed company were packed. On September 9, the 27th China International Optoelectronic Expo (CIOE) opened at the Shenzhen World Exhibition & Convention Center. Many industry insiders said that amid the continued global expansion of AI computing infrastructure, the optical communications industry is expected to grow at a higher pace; technologies such as co-packaged optics (CPO), near-packaged optics (NPO), and optical circuit switching (OCS) are iterating faster than expected, driving sustained high prosperity upstream in optical fiber and cable, PCBs, and MLCCs. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 尿素价格急涨，化肥行业“金九”行情受关注
headlines.summary: 9月份以来，国内尿素市场走出年内少见的急涨行情。生意社监测数据显示，9月9日尿素基准价报1822.50元/吨，较9月初的1715元/吨上涨107.5元/吨，涨幅6.27%。特别是在9月7日，主流地区中小颗粒尿素出厂报价单日上调幅度为50元/吨至150元/吨，山东临沂小颗粒尿素送到价一度升至1830元/吨。现货市场的异动同步传导至二级市场。9月8日，A股化肥板块多只个股涨停。价格急涨之下，这轮行情的成色与持续性，备受市场关注。（证券日报）

headlines.title_en: Urea prices surge sharply, drawing attention to the fertilizer industry's 'golden September' trend
headlines.summary_en: Since September, the domestic urea market has seen a rare sharp rally this year. Monitoring data from Shengyi She showed that the urea benchmark price on September 9 was RMB 1,822.50/ton, up RMB 107.50/ton from RMB 1,715 at the start of September, a gain of 6.27%. Especially on September 7, ex-works quotes for small- and medium-grain urea in mainstream regions rose RMB 50-150/ton in a single day, with delivered prices for small-grain urea in Linyi, Shandong, once climbing to RMB 1,830/ton. The spot market's anomaly simultaneously transmitted to the secondary market. On September 8, multiple fertilizer stocks in A-shares hit the daily limit. With prices surging sharply, the quality and sustainability of this rally have drawn much market attention. (Securities Daily)

headlines.title: 半月内三度召开专题会议，国家发改委研究加强“六张网”建设要素保障工作
headlines.summary: 近日，国家发展改革委党组成员、副主任岳修虎主持召开“六张网”重大项目协调推进会，研究加强要素保障工作。这已是近期围绕“六张网”召开的第三次高规格专题会议。会议提出，要充分发挥各级要素保障机制作用，主动加强与项目单位的对接，精准高效做好用地、用海、环评等要素保障，共同推动“六张网”重大项目加快落地实施。专家表示，下半年要着力推动“六张网”建设从规划布局阶段更快转向形成实物工作量的阶段，将实现对产业链上下游更大的拉动作用。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Third special meeting in half a month: NDRC studies strengthening factor support for building the 'six networks'
headlines.summary_en: Recently, Yue Xiuhu, Deputy Director of the National Development and Reform Commission, chaired a coordination meeting on major projects for the 'six networks,' studying the strengthening of factor guarantees. This is already the third high-level special meeting on the 'six networks' in the near term. The meeting proposed fully leveraging factor guarantee mechanisms at all levels, proactively strengthening coordination with project units, and providing precise and efficient guarantees for land, sea use, and environmental assessments, jointly promoting the accelerated implementation of major 'six networks' projects. Experts say that in the second half of the year, efforts should focus on pushing the 'six networks' construction faster from the planning stage into concrete physical output, which will generate greater driving effects on upstream and downstream industry chains. (Shanghai Securities News)
